title: BSTitle
description: Display fully customizable titles and subtitles on players' screens when they enter your predefined regions!
body:
# BSTitle
A lightweight area title plugin for Paper 1.20–1.21.11. Show custom titles/subtitles to players when they enter preset regions!

## ✨ Core Features
- 🪓 Wooden axe for quick area selection
- 🎨 Full Minecraft color code support for titles/subtitles
- ⏱ Custom fade-in/stay/fade-out durations
- ⚡ No dependencies, Paper-optimized performance
- 💾 Persistent data storage (configs survive restarts)
- 🌐 Bilingual (Chinese/English) config & command feedback

## 🚀 Quick Start
1. Drop `BSTitle.jar` into `plugins/`
2. Restart your Paper server
3. Run `/bst tool` → select area → `/bst create <name> [message]`

## 📌 Core Commands
| Command | Permission | Description |
|---------|------------|-------------|
| `/bst tool` | `bstitle.admin` | Get area selection axe |
| `/bst pos1/pos2` | `bstitle.admin` | Set area diagonal points |
| `/bst create <name> [message]` | `bstitle.admin` | Create a title area |
| `/bst remove/list/info` | `bstitle.admin` | Manage existing areas |
| `/bst setsubtitle/seteffect` | `bstitle.admin` | Customize title effects |
| `/bst reload` | `bstitle.admin` | Reload config/data |
| `/bst help` | `bstitle.user` | Show help menu |

## ⚠️ Important Notes
- 📌 Only for Paper 1.20–1.21.11 (no client mods required)
- 🎨 Color codes: Use `&` prefix (e.g., `&aWelcome! &7Nice to see you`)
- ⚙️ Config file: `plugins/BSTitle/config.yml` (reload with `/bst reload`)
